text:
Marta: Quick idea — let's build a small "deploy snippet bank" + parameterized templates for deployctl/deploy-bot. Collect common flags, canaries, rollback commands, and release-note auto-fillers. Draft here: https://redwood/internal/deploy-snippets (WIP). Wanted to capture everyone's common workflows so bots/templates can surface them.

Owen: love it. we keep too many ad-hoc docs. +1 for making deploy-bot support a --template argument.

Elaine: templates should include: preflight checks, schema migration window marker, and explicit --change-window param. Also include a 'safety fallback' rollback command.

Raj: example template idea — pin + canary + rollback on error 5xx. snippet:
```
deployctl rollout --service payments --image rwd/payments:v3.4 \
  --canary 5% --staging 20m --pin --change-window 2026-03-25T22:00Z \
  --on-fail "deployctl rollback --service payments --to-tag v3.3"
```

Marta: nice. can we standardize the --on-fail string so bots can parse and execute? maybe define a 'rollback:cmd' field in template.

Owen: and add a --dry-run flag that triggers deploy-bot to do all preflight checks but not mutate infra. current bot has --dryrun but it's inconsistent.

deploy-bot: I can accept new flags. propose API: `/deploy --template <name> --vars key=val --dry-run --pin --change-window <iso>`. I will return preflight report + preview of rollout plan. :robot_face:

Tim: also capture release-note convenient text: template can include 'release_summary' and 'migration_notes' so release-note generation becomes a one-click step.

Elaine: For rollback snippets we should include 'quick-revert' and 'db-only-migration-rollback' variations. Keep them under a 'severity' tag (sev1, sev2, manual).

Raj: small UX ask — when deploy-bot sees --pin it should annotate the PR/release with the pinned version and add a human approval step if outside change window.

Marta: agreed. Ok next step — I'll open a PR with a JSON schema for template files (fields: name, description, steps[], rollback_cmd, severity, release_summary_template). Can you all review?

Owen: ping me when PR open. I'll add linting and a CLI helper to render templates with vars.

Elaine: can we add a 'snapshot' script too that captures current cluster state as a link (kubectl snapshot -> S3) and include link in release notes?

Marta: yep. I'll include a sample snapshot hook.

deploy-bot: noted. When PR lands I will add a /deploy template registry endpoint. I will also accept `--annotate-release` to push release notes to Github PR.

Raj: :thumbsup:

Marta: thanks everyone. filing follow-ups: 1) PR w/ schema 2) example templates for payments + embeddings 3) bot flag change proposal. target end of week.
